add-text-field-to-pdf-page.title: Add Text Field to PDF Page Using FormEditor
add-text-field-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to add a text form field named 'CustomerName' to page 1 of an existing PDF using the Aspose.Pdf Facades FormEditor API.

add-unchecked-checkbox-field-to-pdf.title: Add Unchecked Checkbox Field to PDF Form
add-unchecked-checkbox-field-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert an unchecked checkbox named "AgreeTerms" on page 2 of an existing PDF using the Aspose.Pdf Facades FormEditor.

add-radio-button-group-to-pdf-form.title: Add Radio Button Group to PDF Form
add-radio-button-group-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to insert a radio button group named PaymentMethod with "Credit" and "PayPal" options on page 3 of an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-javascript-alert-to-push-button.title: Attach JavaScript Alert to PDF Push Button
add-javascript-alert-to-push-button.description: Shows how to bind an existing PDF, add a JavaScript alert to a push button named "ShowInfo", and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

decorate-pdf-form-field-appearance.title: Decorate PDF Form Field with Custom Appearance
decorate-pdf-form-field-appearance.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf Facades to apply a custom border color, background shade, and font style to an existing form field named "CustomerName" in a PDF document.

set-form-field-alignment-to-center.title: Set Form Field Alignment to Center
set-form-field-alignment-to-center.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor to change the horizontal alignment of a PDF form field named "Address" to center and save the modified PDF.

set-custom-attribute-on-pdf-form-field.title: Assign Custom Data Attribute to PDF Form Field
set-custom-attribute-on-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to add a custom "data-id" attribute to a PDF form field by injecting a JavaScript snippet with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor.

set-numeric-limit-for-pdf-form-field.title: Set Numeric Limit for PDF TextBox Field
set-numeric-limit-for-pdf-form-field.description: Loads a PDF, finds the TextBox form field named "Quantity", and attaches a JavaScript validation action that restricts the entered value to the range 1‑100.

add-list-item-to-pdf-dropdown.title: Add List Item to Dropdown Field in PDF
add-list-item-to-pdf-dropdown.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor to add a new option to an existing dropdown (combo box) form field in a PDF document and save the changes.

remove-list-item-from-pdf-form.title: Remove List Item from PDF Form List Box
remove-list-item-from-pdf-form.description: Shows how to delete the "Option B" entry from a ListBox form field named "Choices" on page 4 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

copy-field-content-between-pdf-form-fiel.title: Copy Form Field Value Between PDF Fields
copy-field-content-between-pdf-form-fiel.description: Shows how to read a value from one PDF form field and write it to another field in the same document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form.

clone-form-field-to-page-5.title: Copy Outer Field Definition to New Field on Page 5
clone-form-field-to-page-5.description: Shows how to copy the appearance (outer) definition of an existing PDF form field to a newly created field on a specified page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor.

move-pdf-form-field.title: Move PDF Form Field to Specified Coordinates on Page 2
move-pdf-form-field.description: Loads a PDF, binds a FormEditor, and moves the form field "DateField" to lower‑left coordinates (100,200) with width 150 and height 20 on page 2, then saves the updated document.

remove-pdf-form-field.title: Remove Form Field from PDF
remove-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to delete an existing form field from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf's FormEditor facade.

add-email-validation-javascript-to-pdf-f.title: Add Email Validation JavaScript to PDF Form Field
add-email-validation-javascript-to-pdf-f.description: Demonstrates how to attach a JavaScript blur‑event script to an "Email" form field in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's FormEditor facade.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-fdf.title: Export PDF Form Fields to FDF
export-pdf-form-fields-to-fdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, binding it to the Form facade, and exporting all form field values to an FDF file for external processing.

import-xfdf-data-into-pdf-form.title: Import XFDF Data into PDF Form Fields
import-xfdf-data-into-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, import field values from an XFDF file using the Form facade, and save the updated PDF with the populated form fields.

decorate-checkbox-fields-in-pdfs.title: Apply Consistent Decoration to Checkbox Fields in PDFs
decorate-checkbox-fields-in-pdfs.description: Shows how to batch‑process PDFs in a directory, use FormEditor to set uniform border and background colors for all checkbox form fields, and save the decorated files.

batch-update-submit-button-urls.title: Update Submit Button URLs in PDFs
batch-update-submit-button-urls.description: Processes a folder of PDF files, finds button form fields, replaces their OnActivated action with a SubmitFormAction pointing to a new URL, and saves the updated PDFs.

clear-and-populate-list-box-field.title: Clear and Populate Dropdown List in PDF Form
clear-and-populate-list-box-field.description: Demonstrates how to remove all existing options from a PDF form dropdown (list box) field and then add new items using Aspose.Pdf.

populate-country-list-box-pdf.title: Add Country List Box to PDF
populate-country-list-box-pdf.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF, adding a ListBox form field, and populating it with 195 country names using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor.

set-form-field-readonly-currency-appeara.title: Set PDF Form Field to Read‑Only and Format as Currency
set-form-field-readonly-currency-appeara.description: Shows how to retrieve a text box form field, assign a currency‑formatted value, make the field read‑only, and save the updated PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

attach-javascript-clear-discountcode-fie.title: Attach JavaScript to PDF Form Field
attach-javascript-clear-discountcode-fie.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's FormEditor facade to add a JavaScript action that clears a form field when it receives focus.

copy-form-fields-from-template-to-pdf.title: Copy Form Fields from Template PDF to Another PDF
copy-form-fields-from-template-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to extract form field definitions from a template PDF and copy them into another PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

move-pdf-form-fields-by-offset.title: Move PDF Form Fields by Offset
move-pdf-form-fields-by-offset.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all form fields, shifts each field's rectangle by a fixed (10,15) point offset, and saves the updated document.

batch-rename-pdf-form-fields.title: Batch Rename PDF Form Fields with Prefix
batch-rename-pdf-form-fields.description: Demonstrates how to retrieve all form field names from a PDF and rename those that start with "Old_" to a new "New_" prefix using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

set-text-field-to-multiline.title: Set Multiline Property for PDF Text Field
set-text-field-to-multiline.description: Shows how to enable multiline input for the 'Comments' text box form field in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-signature-field-border-width.title: Set Border Width for PDF Form Field
set-signature-field-border-width.description: Demonstrates how to apply a custom border thickness of 2 points to a specific form field (Signature) in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor.

set-form-field-background-color.title: Set Form Field Appearance with FormEditor
set-form-field-background-color.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF using FormEditor, applying a field appearance via SetFieldAppearance, and saving the document. It also highlights that the two‑argument overload cannot set a background color.

attach-js-validation-to-pdf-submit-butto.title: Add JavaScript Validation to PDF Submit Button
attach-js-validation-to-pdf-submit-butto.description: Demonstrates how to add a push‑button to a PDF and attach JavaScript that validates required fields before submitting the form using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

create-pdf-form-fields-from-json.title: Create PDF Form Fields from JSON
create-pdf-form-fields-from-json.description: Reads a JSON file that defines form fields and programmatically adds matching TextBox, CheckBox, RadioButton, and ComboBox fields to a new PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

set-phone-number-field-limit.title: Set Maximum Length for PDF Form Field
set-phone-number-field-limit.description: Demonstrates how to limit the number of characters a user can enter in a PDF form field using Aspose.Pdf's FormEditor.SetFieldLimit method.

set-date-field-format.title: Set Date Field Format in PDF Form
set-date-field-format.description: Demonstrates how to change the display format of a DateField in a PDF form to "MM/dd/yyyy" using Aspose.Pdf.

add-reset-form-button-to-pdf.title: Add Reset Form Button to PDF
add-reset-form-button-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a push button in a PDF that clears all form fields when clicked, using Aspose.Pdf's form and JavaScript features.

restrict-pdf-form-field-to-integer-0-100.title: Validate Integer Range for PDF Form Field
restrict-pdf-form-field-to-integer-0-100.description: Demonstrates how to attach JavaScript validation to a PDF form field using Aspose.Pdf.Facades so that the "Score" field accepts only integer values between 0 and 100.

attach-javascript-validation-to-pdf-form.title: Attach JavaScript Validation to PDF Form Field
attach-javascript-validation-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load a PDF, attach a JavaScript script to the "Age" form field that alerts when the value is less than 18, and save the modified document.

remove-empty-pdf-form-field.title: Remove Empty PDF Form Field
remove-empty-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to read a form field's value and delete the field only when it contains no user‑entered data using Aspose.Pdf Facades.

rename-pdf-form-fields-csv-mapping.title: Rename PDF Form Fields Using a CSV Mapping
rename-pdf-form-fields-csv-mapping.description: Demonstrates how to load a field‑name mapping from a CSV file and rename form fields in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor.

add-digital-signature-field-and-sign-pdf.title: Add Digital Signature Field and Sign PDF
add-digital-signature-field-and-sign-pdf.description: Shows how to create a signature field named "DigitalSignature" in a PDF and then sign the document using a PKCS#12 certificate with default appearance settings.

mark-pdf-form-field-required.title: Set PDF Form Field as Required with Asterisk Indicator
mark-pdf-form-field-required.description: Demonstrates how to mark a PDF form field as required using Aspose.Pdf's FormEditor, which automatically displays the asterisk indicator.

apply-custom-font-to-pdf-form-text-field.title: Apply Custom Font to PDF Form Text Fields
apply-custom-font-to-pdf-form-text-field.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate over its form fields, and set the Arial Bold font for all text box fields using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-selectall-checkbox-to-pdf.title: Add SelectAll Checkbox to PDF First Page
batch-add-selectall-checkbox-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a folder of PDF files, add a checkbox form field named "SelectAll" to the first page of each document, and save the modified PDFs to an output folder.

move-footernote-to-bottom-margin.title: Move FooterNote Form Field to Bottom Margin of Each PDF Page
move-footernote-to-bottom-margin.description: Shows how to reposition a form field named FooterNote to the bottom margin on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-field-appearance-format-price.title: Set Price Field Appearance in PDF Form
set-field-appearance-format-price.description: Demonstrates using the FormEditor facade to bind a PDF, set the appearance of the "Price" form field with SetFieldAppearance, and save the updated document.

attach-javascript-to-pdf-form-field.title: Attach JavaScript to Update Total Price from Quantity Field
attach-javascript-to-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to bind a PDF with FormEditor, add a JavaScript action to the "Quantity" field that calculates the "TotalPrice" field, and save the modified document.

export-import-pdf-form-xml.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON
export-import-pdf-form-xml.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, verify that it contains form fields, and export those fields to a JSON file for archival and later re‑import.

import-pdf-form-fields-from-xml-preserve.title: Import PDF Form Fields from XML Preserving Field Order
import-pdf-form-fields-from-xml-preserve.description: Shows how to load a PDF, import form field values from an XML file using the Form facade, and save the updated PDF while keeping the original field order.

add-list-box-field-to-pdf-form.title: Add List Box Field with Default Selection to PDF
add-list-box-field-to-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to create a ListBox form field in a PDF, populate it with items, and set a default selected value using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

remove-button-fields-from-pdf-form.title: Remove Button Fields from PDF Form
remove-button-fields-from-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate all button form fields, delete them, and save the resulting document using Aspose.Pdf.

merge-pdf-forms-unique-field-names.title: Rename Duplicate PDF Form Field Names in Batch
merge-pdf-forms-unique-field-names.description: Demonstrates how to detect duplicate form field names in a PDF and rename them with incremental indexes using Aspose.Pdf's Form and FormEditor facades.

add-email-validation-to-pdf-form-field.title: Add Email Regex Validation to PDF Form Field
add-email-validation-to-pdf-form-field.description: Demonstrates how to apply a JavaScript regular‑expression validation script to an "Email" form field in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor.

add-hidden-version-field-to-pdf.title: Add Hidden Numeric Field to PDF Form
add-hidden-version-field-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a hidden numeric form field named "Version" with a value of 2 in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

copy-rename-pdf-form-field.title: Copy Outer Form Field to New Field on a Specific Page
copy-rename-pdf-form-field.description: Demonstrates how to copy the outer definition of an existing PDF form field (AddressBlock) to a new field (BillingAddress) on page 3 using Aspose.Pdf's FormEditor facade.

move-signature-field-to-lower-right-corn.title: Move Signature Field to Lower‑Right Corner on Page 5
move-signature-field-to-lower-right-corn.description: Demonstrates how to reposition an existing signature form field (or add it if missing) to the lower‑right corner of page 5 with exact dimensions using Aspose.Pdf.

add-form-load-javascript-to-pdf.title: Add JavaScript to Populate Date Field on PDF Open
add-form-load-javascript-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to attach a JavaScript action to a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf so that the "Date" form field is automatically filled with the current date when the PDF is opened.

export-checkbox-fields-to-fdf.title: Export Checkbox Field Definitions to FDF
export-checkbox-fields-to-fdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate its form fields, select only checkbox fields, and write their definitions to an FDF file using a simple custom writer.

import-checkboxes-from-fdf.title: Import Checkbox Definitions from FDF and Merge into PDF Form
import-checkboxes-from-fdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, read checkbox entries from an FDF file, and add those checkboxes to the PDF form while avoiding duplicate field names.

add-state-combobox-to-pdf.title: Add State Combo Box to PDF Form
add-state-combobox-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a combo box field named "State" into an existing PDF and fill it with US state abbreviations using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

remove-non-whitelisted-items-from-pdf-co.title: Remove Disallowed Options from PDF List Box Field
remove-non-whitelisted-items-from-pdf-co.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate a list box form field, and delete any options that are not present in a predefined whitelist, then save the updated document.

make-taxrate-readonly-add-js.title: Make PDF Form Field Read‑Only and Add JavaScript Tax Calculation
make-taxrate-readonly-add-js.description: Demonstrates how to set a PDF form field (TaxRate) to read‑only and attach JavaScript that calculates its value from the Subtotal field using Aspose.Pdf.

decorate-list-fields-uniform-border.title: Decorate List Fields with Uniform Border and Background
decorate-list-fields-uniform-border.description: Loads a PDF, finds all ListBox form fields, and applies a consistent border, background color, and font style using Aspose.Pdf facades.

rename-pdf-form-fields-to-camelcase.title: Rename PDF Form Fields to camelCase
rename-pdf-form-fields-to-camelcase.description: The example reads all form field names from a PDF, converts each name to camelCase, and renames the fields using Aspose.Pdf.Facades FormEditor, then saves the updated PDF.

add-print-button-to-pdf.title: Add Print Button to PDF Form
add-print-button-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a push‑button field into an existing PDF and attach JavaScript that opens the print dialog using Aspose.Pdf Facades.

set-pdf-form-field-hidden-exportable.title: Hide PDF Form Field While Keeping It Exportable
set-pdf-form-field-hidden-exportable.description: Demonstrates how to set a PDF form field to hidden without disabling its export in form data submissions using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

copy-notes-to-summary.title: Copy Notes Field to Summary in PDF Form
copy-notes-to-summary.description: Shows how to read the value of a "Notes" form field and write it to a "Summary" field in a completed PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

move-pdf-form-fields-page-2.title: Shift PDF Form Fields on Page 2 Right by 5 Points
move-pdf-form-fields-page-2.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF form fields and move those located on page 2 5 points to the right using Aspose.Pdf's FormEditor.

set-numeric-validation-two-decimal-disco.title: Restrict Discount Field to Numeric Values with Two Decimal Places
set-numeric-validation-two-decimal-disco.description: Demonstrates how to configure a PDF form field to accept only numeric input with up to two decimal places using the Aspose.Pdf Facades API.

add-confirmation-dialog-to-pdf-submit-bu.title: Add Confirmation Dialog to Submit Button in PDF Form
add-confirmation-dialog-to-pdf-submit-bu.description: Demonstrates locating a button field in a PDF form and attaching a JavaScript action that shows a confirmation dialog before submitting the form.

add-gender-radio-button-group.title: Add Gender Radio Button Group to PDF Form
add-gender-radio-button-group.description: Shows how to create a 'Gender' radio button group with Male, Female, and Other options, set a default selection, and add it to a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-temporary-form-fields-from-pdf.title: Remove Temporary Form Fields from PDF
remove-temporary-form-fields-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to delete form fields whose names start with "Temp_" from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades. The example loads the document, identifies temporary fields, removes them, and saves the cleaned PDF.

convert-single-line-to-multiline-word-wr.title: Enable Multiline and Auto‑Size for PDF Form Field
convert-single-line-to-multiline-word-wr.description: Loads a PDF, binds it to a FormEditor, and sets the "Address" form field to multiline (auto‑wrap) and to expand its height dynamically using PropertyFlag values, then saves the updated document.

add-hidden-authtoken-field-to-pdf.title: Add Hidden AuthToken to PDF Pages
add-hidden-authtoken-field-to-pdf.description: Shows how to generate a secure random token and embed it as invisible text on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

move-pdf-form-field-to-top-left.title: Move PDF Form Field to Top‑Left Corner
move-pdf-form-field-to-top-left.description: Shows how to reposition an existing form field named "Logo" to the top‑left corner of the first page with a defined width and height using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-phone-number-input-mask.title: Set Input Mask on PDF Form Field
apply-phone-number-input-mask.description: Demonstrates how to apply an input mask to a PDF form field by attaching a JavaScript snippet using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor.

attach-js-resetform-clear-hidden-fields.title: Attach Js Resetform Clear Hidden Fields

export-pdf-form-field-layout-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Field Layout to JSON
export-pdf-form-field-layout-to-json.description: Loads a PDF, extracts each form field's name and rectangle coordinates, and writes the layout data to a formatted JSON file for UI reconstruction.

import-pdf-form-layout-from-json.title: Import Form Field Layout from JSON to PDF
import-pdf-form-layout-from-json.description: Reads a JSON file that defines form field positions and types, then creates a new PDF with those fields placed on the specified pages.

batch-add-hidden-guid-field-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add Hidden ProcessedDate Field to PDFs
batch-add-hidden-guid-field-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over PDF files in a folder, add a hidden TextBoxField named "ProcessedDate" to each document, populate it with a GUID, and save the changes.

add-hidden-sessionid-field-to-pdfs-batch.title: Add Hidden SessionId Field to PDFs in Batch
add-hidden-sessionid-field-to-pdfs-batch.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over a folder of PDF files, generate a GUID for each, and add a hidden text field named "SessionId" to the first page using Aspose.Pdf.

decorate-pdf-form-field-italic-gray.title: Apply Italic Font and Gray Background to PDF Form Footer
decorate-pdf-form-field-italic-gray.description: Shows how to locate a PDF form field named "Footer" and style it with an italic Arial font and a light gray background using Aspose.Pdf.

add-submit-button-to-pdf-form__v2.title: Add Submit Button to PDF Form
add-submit-button-to-pdf-form__v2.description: Shows how to insert a push‑button field on the first page of a PDF and configure it to post form data to a specified URL using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

apply-default-decoration-to-text-fields.title: Apply Default Decoration to All Text Fields in a PDF
apply-default-decoration-to-text-fields.description: The example loads a PDF, configures default font, colors, border, and alignment via FormEditor’s FormFieldFacade, and applies these settings to every text field in the document before saving.

set-custom-image-background-for-signatur.title: Apply Custom Image Background to PDF Signature Field
set-custom-image-background-for-signatur.description: Shows how to set a custom visual appearance with an image background for a PDF signature field using Aspose.Pdf Facades API.

rename-pdf-form-field__v2.title: Rename PDF Form Field Using Aspose.Pdf
rename-pdf-form-field__v2.description: Shows how to rename a form field in a PDF document by binding the PDF with FormEditor, calling RenameField, and saving the result.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v5.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v5.description: Loads a PDF document, extracts its form field definitions and current values, and writes them to an indented JSON file for use by external systems.

duplicate-pdf-form-field__v2.title: Copy Form Field Appearance to New Field
duplicate-pdf-form-field__v2.description: Demonstrates how to duplicate the outer appearance of an existing PDF form field using the FormEditor facade and save the modified document.
